title: Slack app
description: Slack's Web API, for one app installed in one workspace, whether it receives events over Socket Mode or at an HTTP endpoint.

members.name: baseURL
members.description: HTTPS base URL of the Slack Web API; without it, the vendor's public one.

members.name: botToken
members.description: The app's bot token, in the vendor's format, which is not validated.

members.name: appToken
members.description: The app-level token a Socket Mode connection opens with.

members.name: signingSecret
members.description: The secret that verifies each request Slack sends to an HTTP events endpoint.
